arguments.Title: Record observed passenger transport
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) {var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); var v=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<VehicleController>(); var hud=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); if(c==null||!c.Connected||v==null||hud==null||hud.OperatorControls==null){result.Log("NOT_READY");return;} hud.OperatorControls.SelectVehicle("V01"); Camera cam=null; foreach(var candidate in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) if(candidate.enabled&&candidate.targetTexture==null)cam=candidate; var rec=v.GetComponent<CampusDriveTelemetry>(); if(rec==null)rec=v.gameObject.AddComponent<CampusDriveTelemetry>(); rec.Begin(v,c,cam,"artifacts/high_speed_drive/request-ui-anniversary-biryong.csv",900); result.Log("READY status="+c.Status+" reason="+c.DiagnosticReason); } }
